acceptance_credit_rule: PASS requires terminal exact-head executable evidence on the candidate being classified; an open owner PR, historical green SHA, self-authored owner test, or model-only oracle is not PASS.

fault_modes.inject: Force the externally visible effect to occur, then terminate before durable state/result publication.
must_assert: restart classifies the effect as completed or uncertain from canonical evidence
recovery does not blindly repeat the effect
canonical owner retains project and operation identity

fault_modes.inject: Commit durable intent/state, then terminate before the externally visible effect starts.
must_assert: restart observes the committed intent
effect executes at most once from the same operation identity
state cannot falsely claim a terminal external result

fault_modes.inject: Complete the effect but lose the acknowledgement/result before the caller can persist or receive it.
must_assert: retry reconciles or replays by exact idempotency identity
no second externally visible effect is produced
the recovered result is bound to the original project and authority

fault_modes.inject: Submit the same logical operation twice with the same canonical identity.
must_assert: both calls converge on one canonical receipt/result
duplicate execution is prevented
conflicting reuse of the same identity fails closed

fault_modes.inject: Release two same-scope writers/recoverers at the same deterministic synchronization barrier.
must_assert: one serialization order or one deterministic conflict is observed
no lost update occurs
both outcomes remain attributable to the canonical owner

fault_modes.inject: Persist a newer authoritative revision, then restart or retry from an older checkpoint/snapshot.
must_assert: older authority cannot overwrite or regain current authority
stale lineage is rejected or classified explicitly
newer durable state remains unchanged

fault_modes.inject: Corrupt a durable type, schema version, row version, revision, or encoded authority field before restart.
must_assert: restore fails closed without permissive coercion
no external effect executes from corrupt state
corruption cannot cross project or owner boundaries

fault_modes.inject: Start two independent recovery hosts against the same durable authority and release them together.
must_assert: only one recovery owner may mutate or dispatch the protected effect
the loser observes deterministic conflict/reconciliation
no second authority store or process-local winner claim is accepted
